sensitivity_controller.limitation: No candidate impact ranges, uncertainty bases, dependent decision lists or alternatives are declared in the current input; numeric sensitivity remains unavailable.

notes: The current offline catalogue has 416 records: 72 sources, 16 products, 5 offers, 3 FX observations and 320 benchmarks. The July 2026 CSO bulletin contributes 16 origin-separated material prices and 90 governorate/category wage observations normalized from daily rates using an explicit 8-hour day. These are statistical inputs, not supplier quotations.

Three new discovery records describe the July 2026 CSO bulletin, SCOSI machining work for an aluminium extrusion press, and the listed Iraqi Cement State Company Samawa plant. The industrial records are leads only; they do not establish railway products, current output, grade, availability or price.

The ready-mix listing reports C15/C25/C30/C36 production and 60–120 m3/h capacity for Baghdad facilities, but does not establish project allocation, mix design, concrete test results, delivery, pumping price or suitability for prestressed guideway beams.

Official 2024 industrial statistics report annual average payroll of IQD 12.5 million at large and IQD 6.3 million at medium establishments. These are annual factory-worker wage statistics, not hourly skilled railway-fabrication charge-out rates.

The official 2025 import report has not been downloaded, table-extracted or unit-normalized; no material quantity or unit-price observation was added from it. Iraqi Cement State Company price tiles remain unparsed. The Ministry indicative construction-price bulletin is described as under preparation and contributes no rates.

All domestic estimates use source-linked material quantity × source rate plus declared labour hours × source wage, followed by an explicit 20% planning uplift where stated. The uplift applies only to represented direct material and labour; labour hours are assumptions, and employer charges, utilities, tooling, QA, waste, taxes, transport and installation remain excluded unless represented.

The current 416-record catalogue identity and 72-source registry identity are recorded above. Frame/federated price-evaluation packets remain pinned to the retained 305-record epoch; v10 laminate studies use all 416 current seed records. The current v7 procurement package packet links six July 2026 concrete estimate cases per span and preserves 27,216 located occurrences plus separate unlocated obligations. The 2025 regional reference, September 2026 material screen, candidate takeoff and historical 2024 material cross-check remain separately source-bound. Digital evidence does not establish physical qualification, supplier acceptance or complete installed cost.
source_epoch_definition: SHA-256 identity() of the validated offline seed record list returned by engineering.sourcing.catalogue.load_catalogue(); packet-specific catalogue snapshots may additionally contain generated process records.

limitations: The 2025 CSO regional bulletin contributes Iraqi-origin construction-material and governorate/category wage benchmarks. Source-table zeros remain unavailable; three concrete recipes are held where at least one input price is missing.

Regional 2025 and 2026 Baghdad estimates use explicit material + assumed labour hours + 20% scenarios. Only the 2025 Baghdad concrete scenario is mapped to exact research-candidate nominal concrete groups and original occurrences. Neither is a finished beam or installed civil cost.

New factory and procurement leads are not operational-capacity evidence, technically accepted products or supplier quotations. Import report, price-image and construction-bulletin leads add no parsed price observations.

The 2024 CSO report is a modeled private-building estimate that uses 2024 permits and price/wage bulletins with material-use ratios from a 2012 survey; its cost/quantity ratios are historical statistical indicators, not observed supplier transactions.
The 2024 report excludes Kurdistan Region; the 2025 wage comparator uses the Baghdad governorate annual construction-worker average.
Normal grit is not confirmed to be interchangeable with the 2025 CSO crushed-gravel category; grading, strength and delivery scope are unknown.
The concrete recipe and labour hours are sensitivity assumptions, not a mix design, verified yield, timed factory route or candidate-specific bill of quantities.
The 20% uplift applies only to declared material plus direct labour and is an unallocated planning allowance, not verified overhead, profit, tax or contingency.

regional_cost_reference_2026_07.formula: (material quantity x source rate + person-hours x hourly base wage) x 1.20
